description: This dataset from Spain's markets and competition regulator gives yearly telecommunications figures by province and autonomous community, including fixed and mobile lines, broadband accesses by technology (FTTH, xDSL and HFC), subscribers and mobile base stations by technology up to 5G, broken down for the main operators such as Movistar, Orange, Vodafone and Digi. It is part of the CNMCData open data service, which also publishes national market series, and runs from 2007 to 2025, last updated in September 2026. Data can be downloaded in CSV, JSON, XML and RDF or retrieved through the CNMC data API. Coverage: Spain, 50 provinces and 19 autonomous communities and cities, annual since 2007. Format and access: web page, files and API, free under the CNMC terms of use. Caveats: base station counts are aggregated by province, not located; operator categories change over time; the reuse licence is not stated on the page. Simulation uses: regional distribution of network assets and demand for exposure and capacity studies, and trends in technology mix. Related records: ARCEP and Anatel publish comparable regulator data for France and Brazil.
